judgment.notes: H002 supplies smooth coordinate restrictions on the open domain, so the first and second product rules apply in time and each spatial coordinate. H004 holds throughout these restrictions, rather than merely at the fixed point. H001 supplies positive finite dimensions. H005 supplies exactly the pointwise normality witness used; no differentiation of that witness occurs. There are no E/M applications.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
